## Extra-provincial registration

A business in Canada is incorporated federally or in the province or territory where it does business. If it wants to do business in another province or territory, it may also have to register there. This is known as extra-provincial registration.

## Annual filings overdue

At least one annual filings has not been filed within 60 days of the corporation's anniversary date. You cannot get a Certificate of Compliance

##

## Annual filings overdue

Two consecutive annuals filings are overdue. Corporations Canada has sent a notice of its intent to dissolve the corporation. If the corporation does not file its annual filings immediately, the corporation would be subject to an administrative dissolution.

## Registered office address

The registered office is the legal address of a corporation.  
  
Active business corporations are required to update the registered office address within 15 days of any change.

## Directors

A director is an individual elected by the shareholders of a corporation to supervise the management of the corporation.
